clue.text: Shying away from taking the plunge

definitions.meaning: to dodge or flinch away from something, as one bobs down to avoid a blow
dipping right under the water, as a swimmer does when diving in

explanation.definitionFit: To duck is both to dodge a thing and to dip under water, so the -ing form fits both senses.

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow or track them
a star is a celebrity; the possessive is no letter

explanation.surface: Stalk a famous person's attractive physique.
explanation.definitionFit: Sirius, the brightest star in the night sky, is a celestial object.

definitions.meaning: a Caribbean style of ballad, originally from Trinidad
the sea nymph of Greek myth who kept the hero on her island for seven years

explanation.surface: A tune that enchanted the wandering Greek hero long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a West Indian ballad style and the nymph who detained Odysseus in Homer's epic.

clue.text: Girl showing passion over loveless one

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the first piece above the next

parts.note: ire is anger, a passion

indicators.note: loveless says the letter for love, a zero shape, is removed from the word

parts.note: taken as written before its letter is removed

explanation.surface: A girl displays strong feeling over somebody without affection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loveless' removes O (love, zero in tennis) from ONE, leaving NE; 'showing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A female given name, borne by the Greek goddess of peace.

definitions.meaning: one who begets or produces offspring

explanation.definitionFit: Something that creates is a begetter, and a dynamo producing electricity is the everyday sense.

definitions.meaning: a reluctance to speak openly or show feelings
to book a table or seat is to secure it in advance

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a person's reluctance to speak is about a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is only a link word here; it tempts the solver to look for RE, which leads nowhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserve means restraint in manner, and as a verb it means to arrange a booking ahead.

definitions.meaning: the idiom for being perfectly well is this word followed by as rain, so it stands in the blank

explanation.surface: A remark that something is simply as ordinary as rainfall.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is a fill-in: the British idiom 'as ___ as rain' means perfectly well or normal again.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means fair or correct, and it is the word in the idiom meaning perfectly well.

clue.text: Refused it when more than satisfied

annotationWithheld.why: Refused it when more than satisfied: an anagram of REFUSED IT with no indicator but 'Refused' itself, which would be fodder and indicator at once
annotationWithheld.clue: Refused it when more than satisfied

indicators.note: before places the earlier pieces ahead of the letter that follows

parts.note: real means genuine
ones read as letters, I's, since I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: mid- says take the central letter of the month name

explanation.surface: Advice to sell authentic items ahead of the middle of autumn's first month.
explanation.walkthrough: September has nine letters, so its middle one is E.
explanation.definitionFit: To realise an asset is to convert it into cash by selling it.

clue.text: High point for the first lady and others

parts.note: Eve, the first woman in the Bible
the rest means the others

explanation.surface: A summit reached by the original woman and her companions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for the' is a link joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's tallest mountain is the highest peak on Earth.

clue.text: The craft with which Spain built up her empire

definitions.text: The craft with which Spain built up her empire

parts.words: The craft with which Spain built up her empire
parts.note: reads like a skill or art, but craft here means a vessel: the great sailing ship that carried Spanish treasure and power

explanation.surface: A history lesson about the skill by which Spain gained its empire.
explanation.definitionFit: This large sailing warship was the mainstay of the sixteenth-century Spanish fleets that carried gold from the Americas.

clue.text: A beggar sorting out contents of bins

indicators.note: sorting out suggests putting things in a new order, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tramp rummages through what's in the dustbins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sorting out' rearranges the seven letters of A BEGGAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbish thrown away is exactly what fills dustbins.

parts.note: highly reads as very, but suggests the highest level of a classification scale for confidential information

explanation.definitionFit: Classified material at the most restricted grade is kept hidden from all but a few, so it is mysterious to a high degree.

clue.text: The Spanish, Italian and English are the best

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
It is a crossword abbreviation for Italian, as in It vermouth

explanation.surface: A patriotic boast that Spanish, Italian and English people are the finest.
explanation.definitionFit: A select group regarded as superior to the rest is the pick, the very finest.

clue.text: They grow down from the torso

indicators.note: from here says the answer is made out of the letters of the word that follows, rearranged

explanation.surface: Something odd is said to sprout downward out of a person's trunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' rearranges TORSO; 'the' is a link word. The torso picture suggests limbs, but the definition is plant parts.
explanation.definitionFit: The underground parts of a plant extend downward into the soil as it grows.

parts.note: vessels may be ships passing over a sandbar or tall glasses passed across a pub counter

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a fore-and-aft rigged sailing ship and a large glass for beer or sherry.

definitions.meaning: the way one handles or behaves towards a person or thing
the medical care given to control an illness

explanation.definitionFit: The noun covers both the way one handles someone and the medical handling of a patient's condition.

indicators.note: discord means disagreement and disorder, so the letters are thrown into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Votes held to quieten disagreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discord' rearranges the nine letters of TO SILENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Polls in which people cast votes to choose representatives.

definitions.meaning: to send out or emit, or to release someone from hospital or service

explanation.surface: An instruction to extinguish a blaze.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as one order to quench flames; it splits into two separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: To discharge is to emit or release, and to discharge a firearm is to shoot it.

clue.text: Entitle one to debts not settled

parts.note: to dub someone is to give that person a title
IOUs are written promises to repay debts

explanation.surface: Give a person a title in exchange for unpaid debts.
explanation.definitionFit: Something uncertain or undecided is doubtful, still open to question.

definitions.meaning: open to suspicion, of questionable reliability
a person thought to be guilty of a crime

explanation.surface: A shady individual.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means questionable, and as a noun it means a person under suspicion.

clue.text: Disney character who demonstrated inarticulate love

parts.note: dumb means unable to speak
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: A cartoon figure who showed affection without words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'who demonstrated' is a link joining the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The flying baby elephant with huge ears is the title figure of a 1941 animated film.

clue.text: It's crazy wearing hair that's artificial

indicators.note: wearing says one piece is clothed in another, so the first goes inside the hair word

parts.note: a mane is a long head of hair
mad means crazy

explanation.surface: Wearing a wig that's fake is madness.
explanation.definitionFit: Something made by people rather than nature is synthetic.

parts.note: suggests a cab driver overcharging, but fare here means food

explanation.definitionFit: Eating more food than one needs is gluttony.

parts.note: a BA is a Bachelor of Arts, so graduates are BAs
so means thus, in this manner

explanation.surface: A vocalist explains the method by which students get their degrees.
explanation.definitionFit: A bass voice, the Italian term naming a male vocalist of the lowest range.

clue.text: Yet it means there's only a slender hope

definitions.text: Yet it means there's only a slender hope

parts.words: Yet it means there's only a slender hope
parts.note: the phrase begins with a word meaning plump, the opposite of slender, yet the idiom signals a slim prospect

explanation.definitionFit: This ironic idiom says that something is very unlikely to happen.

parts.note: put beside a copy of itself, this number forms the phrase for an even split

explanation.definitionFit: The number half of a hundred, doubled up in a phrase, means divided equally between two.

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few callers ring up to book a room.
explanation.definitionFit: An establishment offering rooms for paying guests provides lodging.

clue.text: One's naughty spirit as an individual

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe
an elf is a small mischievous sprite of folklore

explanation.surface: Someone's own mischievous soul is regarded as a person in its own right.
explanation.definitionFit: The reflexive pronoun refers to a person by themselves, a single human being.

parts.note: a batsman dismissed in cricket is out
rage is violent anger

explanation.surface: A sacking delivered in fury causes a public uproar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' joins the two pieces and 'it's a' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A shocking event that provokes public indignation is a disgrace or scandal.

clue.text: Meet, and come up to expectations

definitions.meaning: to meet a demand or need is to fulfil it
to be as good as hoped for

explanation.surface: A request to rendezvous and also live up to what is hoped.
explanation.definitionFit: To fulfil a requirement and to please by being as good as hoped are both senses of the verb.

clue.text: Obvious way to get round the foreigner

indicators.note: get round says one piece encircles another, so the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
an alien is someone from another country

explanation.surface: A plain method for evading an outsider.
explanation.definitionFit: Something prominent and noticeable stands out, so it is conspicuous or evident.
